requests.description:
Returns URLs pointing to images in JPG format in the highest available resolution (depending on the component) of the vehicle's:
  * engine (1024x576 px),
  * rim (710x710 px),
  * trim (800x600 px),
  * paints (800x600 px),
  * upholstery (800x600 px) and
  * equipments (740x416 px).
requests.name: GET /markets/{marketId}/models/{modelId}/configurations/{configurationId}/images/components
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: GET /markets/{marketId}/models/{modelId}/configurations/{configurationId}/images/components

requests.description: Returns a URL pointing to an image of the vehicles engine.  These images are available in the resolution 1024x576 px.
requests.name: GET /markets/{marketId}/models/{modelId}/configurations/{configurationId}/images/components/engine
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: GET /markets/{marketId}/models/{modelId}/configurations/{configurationId}/images/components/engine

requests.description: Returns URLs pointing to images of this vehicle's equipments. The images are available in the highest possible resolution (usually 740x416 px).
requests.name: GET /markets/{marketId}/models/{modelId}/configurations/{configurationId}/images/components/equipments
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: GET /markets/{marketId}/models/{modelId}/configurations/{configurationId}/images/components/equipments
